study type: Observational comparative study (human placental samples) and Experimental animal study (mouse model)
cohort: The study included human placental samples from pregnancies with and without preeclampsia, and C57BL/6J dams (mice) for experimental manipulation.
finding: HDAC9 and RGS2 expression were positively correlated and abundant in syncytiotrophoblast cells, but their expression was substantially reduced in these cells during preeclampsia, with experimental reductions of Rgs2 in mice inducing preeclampsia-like features.
cross-section timing: Analysis of placental samples at the time of delivery.
